name: Lasagna
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the 16 ounces lasagna noodles until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.
Meanwhile, heat the 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the 3 cloves minced garlic and cook 1 minute. Add the 3/4 cup white beans and cook until browned, breaking it up.
Stir in the 1 3/4 cups Alfredo sauce and simmer 8 minutes, loosening with pasta water as needed.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, top with 2/3 cup ricotta, and serve immediately.
